api.B64Reference.compare(step, ddp_encoder,: got={outputs:{h,v,coarse},losses:{total,voltage,coarse},input_grads:[raw_concat_v_grad,raw_concat_image_grad]}; all globals rank0+rank1 order. h=[64,208,512], v=[64,208,1], coarse=[64,256]. Original compare covers outputs/loss/input grads/all named parameter grads/params/delta from original init/AdamW step+moments/buffers, original key set and optimizer coverage required; no tolerance change. On success frees pending step and reference grads.
api.B64Reference.close(): Release model/optimizer/initial/pending immediately after successful step5, or on failure; no all-step model/gradient snapshots retained.

All25 global masks generated by private stream, identical on both ranks; explicit generator does not consume caller RNG
Extra reference initialization and step/probe must preserve caller torch/Python/NumPy RNG; complete reference arithmetic unchanged
S07 checkpoints both per-rank RNG and independent mask stream state; zero-extra-update recovery must check both
S07 records distinct rank training exposure and extra first320 B64 reference observations; S02 helper does not silently mark consumption
ddp_math: S07 computes detached global masked/coarse counts via collectives; loss backward is world_size*(local_voltage_sum/global_mask_count + local_coarse_sum/global_coarse_count). local zero-mask uses differentiable zero, global zero count fails. Logs global sums/counts. Full forward+heads must remain inside DDP.
